name: first-typescript
title: First typescript SDK
description: Generate and build a small typescript package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: the generated TypeScript package builds and exports PetstoreClient

name: first-python
title: First python SDK
description: Generate and build a small python package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: the generated Python package installs and imports PetstoreClient

name: first-rust
title: First rust SDK
description: Generate and build a small rust package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
prerequisites: the pinned Rust toolchain and Cargo
outcome: the generated Rust SDK and CLI build, and the CLI prints help

name: first-mcp
title: First mcp SDK
description: Generate and build a small mcp package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: the generated TypeScript SDK and MCP server package build

name: first-webmcp
title: First webmcp SDK
description: Generate and build a small webmcp package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
prerequisites: Node 22 or later with npm; a compatible browser is required for real browser registration
outcome: the generated SDK and WebMCP browser package build; no browser acceptance is claimed

name: first-docs
title: First agent documentation
description: Generate agent-facing documentation from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: agent documentation is generated, including llms.txt and tools.json

name: first-go
title: First go SDK
description: Generate and build a small go package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: the source-built external Go emitter generates an SDK that go build accepts

name: first-java
title: First java SDK
description: Generate and build a small java package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: Maven builds the generated SDK with the matching Java runtime sources

name: first-csharp
title: First csharp SDK
description: Generate and build a small csharp package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: dotnet builds the generated SDK against the matching C# runtime project

name: first-ruby
title: First ruby SDK
description: Generate and build a small ruby package from a local OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
outcome: the generated gem installs local dependencies and loads petstore_sdk

name: input-openapi30
title: Start with OpenAPI 3.0
description: Initialize directly from a committed native OpenAPI document.
outcome: initialization keeps the original OpenAPI document and generates fresh agent documentation

name: input-openapi31
title: Start with OpenAPI 3.1
description: Initialize directly from a committed native OpenAPI document.
outcome: initialization keeps the original OpenAPI document and generates fresh agent documentation

name: input-postman
title: Start with Postman
description: Import a minimal Postman v2.1 collection offline; requests and scripts are not executed.
outcome: a normalized OpenAPI project and agent documentation are generated from the collection

name: input-curl
title: Start with saved cURL
description: Parse a saved command as data with an explicitly reviewed route; never execute it.
outcome: the routed cURL observation becomes an OpenAPI project and fresh agent documentation

name: input-http
title: Start with an HTTP request file
description: Import a saved HTTP request with an explicit route template.
outcome: the routed HTTP request becomes an OpenAPI project and fresh agent documentation

name: input-har
title: Start with a HAR capture
description: Import a minimal HAR 1.2 observation with its origin and path explicitly selected.
outcome: the reviewed capture becomes an OpenAPI project and fresh agent documentation

name: input-swagger
title: Start with Swagger 2.0
description: Convert a local Swagger document without fetching or guessing unsupported semantics.
outcome: the Swagger document becomes a normalized OpenAPI project and fresh agent documentation

name: input-json-schema
title: Start with JSON Schema models
description: Declare JSON Schema models together with explicit HTTP routing in an endpoint manifest.
prerequisites: no target-specific toolchain; a bare schema alone cannot describe an HTTP API
outcome: the routed declared models become OpenAPI and fresh agent documentation

name: preview-confirmation
title: Preview and confirm a destructive call
description: Reject an unconfirmed deletion, preview its identical arguments, then execute with the returned token.
outcome: a generated client calls the loopback mock, and exactly one DELETE reaches the server

name: local-mock
title: Develop against a local mock
description: Run tungsten mock and call it through the generated Python client with strict response validation.
outcome: the generated client receives a nonempty typed Pet list from a loopback mock

name: mock-scenarios
title: Assert retries with saved mock scenarios
description: Run an explicit integration against saved 429, interrupted-stream, malformed-response and lost-write scenarios, and fail deliberately broken retries.
prerequisites: Linux, macOS or Windows for scenario run; no target-specific toolchain
outcome: four saved scenarios pass, and broken retry, resume and replay behavior fails its assertions

name: ci-drift
title: Detect stale generated files in CI
description: Generate, change a copied contract, observe the no-diff gate fail, then regenerate and pass.
outcome: generate --check fails with TG0901 after a contract change and succeeds after regeneration

name: surface-diff
title: Review semver and migration changes
description: Compare a generated baseline with an additive operation using both diff review modes.
outcome: diff --semver reports a minor change and diff --migration supplies an actionable migration

name: bulk-sync
title: Bulk sync within a quota
description: Bound concurrent calls, queue the rest and share 429 backoff with a request scheduler in TypeScript, Python and Rust.
prerequisites: Python venv and pip, Node 22 or later with npm, and the pinned Rust toolchain and Cargo
outcome: the TypeScript, Python and Rust clients each read 200 records through a request scheduler while the loopback server sees at most 4 concurrent requests and refuses none
